$comment: MEASURED, not restated. Every number here was read out of the shipped WOFF2 binaries at authoring time by decompressing their brotli table streams with Node's zlib and parsing head / OS/2 / maxp / hhea / post / name / cmap directly. Re-measure rather than trust this file if the binaries ever change.

measurement.method: Node stdlib only. WOFF2 header + table directory parsed per the W3C WOFF2 spec (UIntBase128 lengths, 63-entry known-tag table), font data brotli-decompressed with zlib.brotliDecompressSync, then sfnt tables read at their concatenated offsets.
measurement.cmap_subtables_parsed: format 4 (platform 0 enc 3, platform 3 enc 1) and format 6 (platform 1 enc 0). All three were parsed; codepoints mapping to glyph 0 were excluded.
measurement.caveat: glyf and loca are WOFF2-transformed and were NOT reconstructed. Nothing here depends on them: glyph COUNT comes from maxp.numGlyphs and character coverage comes from cmap, both of which are stored untransformed.
measurement.what_this_corrects: T003 reported 262 glyphs from the same binaries. That figure is CONFIRMED exactly (maxp.numGlyphs = 262 in all four files). This measurement adds the character coverage T003 did not report: 294 mapped codepoints across 32 ranges, which is a different and larger number than the glyph count because several codepoints share a glyph.

family.name_discrepancy: The binaries' name ID 1 says "Que Grotesk" while name ID 16 and the full name say "Que Grotesque". Declare the family as "Que Grotesque" in @font-face and do NOT use a local() source — a local() lookup against an ambiguous family name is how a visitor's installed font silently replaces the tested one.
family.note_on_italic: There is no italic and no oblique in this set, which is why `font-synthesis: none` is mandatory and global. Without it the browser fakes both.
family.note_on_monospace: Que Grotesque must never set code. Use ui-monospace (--font-mono).

glyph_coverage.why_codepoints_exceed_glyphs: 294 codepoints map to 262 glyphs because several characters share one outline (for example U+00A0 no-break space and U+0020, or U+2212 minus and U+002D hyphen).

private_use_area.purpose: UNDOCUMENTED. The post table gives these 28 glyphs no descriptive names, and the foundry supplied no documentation for them. Do not rely on them: a PUA codepoint has no meaning to a screen reader, to search, or to any fallback font.
private_use_area.rule: Never use a PUA codepoint in copy. If one of these turns out to be a wanted symbol, it must be shipped as an SVG asset, not as a character.

required_marks.$comment: The footer-marks component needs these. The visual system said to assume nothing and measure. Measured:
required_marks.verdict: All three are present in all four weights. footer-marks can set its trademark and copyright lines in Que Grotesque with no fallback and no SVG substitute.

notable_absences.$comment: Characters an author is likely to reach for that are NOT in the subset. Each one falls back to another face mid-line, which is visible.
notable_absences.U+00B5 µ MICRO SIGN: absent — but U+03BC GREEK SMALL LETTER MU is present and is what the file actually carries
notable_absences.arrows: U+2190–U+2193 all absent. Use an SVG icon, not a character.

language_support.rule: No non-English display copy in Que Grotesque unless the characters have been checked against this file. For a language in `incomplete`, set the whole run in --font-fallback rather than letting the browser substitute glyph by glyph — a run that changes face mid-word looks broken; a run set entirely in the fallback does not.

fallback_stack.css: "Que Grotesque", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, Roboto, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
fallback_stack.derivation: Chosen from the measured coverage above, not assumed. The subset stops at Latin-1 plus a slice of Latin Extended-A, so the fallbacks must be broad-coverage neo-grotesques with a similar x-height, so that a substituted glyph or a substituted run stays visually tolerable. Measured x-height is 0.5459 em and cap height 0.7275 em; Helvetica and Arial sit near 0.52 em x-height, which is the closest widely-installed match.
fallback_stack.not_metric_overridden: No size-adjust / ascent-override / descent-override is declared. The measured metrics are recorded above so a later task can compute them properly rather than guess.
